Traits.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
Traits.text: When Canon makes an attack, he has Advantage on the attack roll.

Actions.name: Star of Iron
Actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning; if target is a creature, it is hexed until end of its next turn. Whenever a hexed creature makes an attack roll or saving throw, roll d4 and subtract it.

Actions.name: Unholy Fire
Actions.text: 2/day; 3rd-level spell. 15-foot-radius, 30-foot-high cylinder within 90 ft.; DC 15 Dexterity save. Fail: 14 (4d6) fire + 14 (4d6) necrotic and move 15 ft. horizontally; success: half damage and no movement.

BonusActions.name: Blessing of Ajax
BonusActions.text: 2/day. Creature within 30 ft. regains 14 (2d8) HP and ends one of blinded, charmed, dazed, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, or stunned.

BonusActions.name: Iron Ring
BonusActions.text: 2/day. Teleport to/from the Cyst as described in the stat block.

LegendaryActions.name: Curse of Iron
LegendaryActions.text: Unleashes a magic hex. Each enemy he can see within 30ft must make DC 15 WIS save. On fail, takes 4d6 necrotic and is blinded for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). On a successful save, half damage and not blinded.

Description: Controller/support. Use Star of Iron to punish movement and Unholy Fire to catch clustered PCs. Blessing of Ajax can restore an important BIP member. Iron Ring 2/day.
